comment: M06 golden-slice art review. Eye-height spectator views of every beat on the authored route, with the guards and both Turrets that are placed from the start. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m06_port_of_entry.json. Look at each still against docs/design/moon.md, the art bible and the Recall Notice bar; this is art review, not combat or fresh-player evidence.

states.name: dock_arrival
states.note: Arrival in the dock bay: the open pressure bulkhead ahead.

states.name: dock_crew
states.note: The dock bay's crew side: control panel, dust declaration and what the crew use here.

states.name: bulkhead_threshold
states.note: Through the open bulkhead into the freight hall.

states.name: earth_window
states.note: The quiet beat: Earth over the gantry through the freight window.

states.name: freight_hall_wide

states.name: freight_guards

states.note: The weighing gantry and pressure cases at fighting distance.

states.name: intro_turret

states.name: inspection_desk
states.note: The west inspection desk, its Clerk and the declaration screen.

states.name: queue_lanes
